subject: general
question:
Read the following information carefully and answer the question given below:

'P & Q' means 'P is the son of Q'.

'P @ Q' means 'P is the brother of Q'.

'P % Q' means 'P is the sister of Q'.

'P $ Q' means 'P is the daughter of Q'.

'P # Q' means 'P is the father of Q'.

How is W related to Z, in the expression 'V & W # T @ X % Y $ Z' ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb0803aeca2b730c642d4ccdfaaa344c817c9d7877eb63c5486d15a149fd3a5f.png] 

Given:

 
 

 P is
 
 

 Symbol

 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Son
 Brother

 of Q
 
 

 

Expression:- V & W # T @ X % Y $ Z

Here,

V & W means V is the son of W.

W # T means W is the father of T.

T @ X means T is the brother of X.

X % Y means X is the sister of Y.

Y $ Z means Y is the daughter of Z

Thus, the following family tree can be drawn:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ec68a4d9589581a51888805a01ca610389c35a9c3ac8ed554516bb6bae17493.png] 

W is the husband of Z.

Hence, the correct answer is __Husband__.
